answer_1.quote: Humans often rely on intuitive Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to perform complex reasoning. Previous studies have shown that this CoT capacity also emerges in Large Language Models (LLMs). Through simple prompting or fine-tuning, CoT enhances the reasoning performance of LLMs while providing insights into their decision-making process.
answer_1.outputs: CoT rationales and answers for multimodal reasoning tasks
